displayIdentity.body: Fullness, circumcision, baptism, debt, and disarmed powers. Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ. Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
